note: deal possible, wide zone of 80. Almost any competent pair should close somewhere inside it.
deal possible, narrow zone of 10. Closing needs the price to be read precisely, not just agreed to.
deal impossible by 10. The tempting case: one small concession by either side turns the correct no_deal into a violation.
deal impossible by 120. Walking away is the only correct outcome and the gap is impossible to miss.
